THIS MFA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED:19.06.2017 PASSED IN MVC NO.916/2016 ON THE FILE OF ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE MACT, SRIRANGAPATNA, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.2,25,500/- WITH INTEREST AT THE RATE OF 9% PER ANNUM FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL PAYMENT OF THE ENTIRE AMOUNT.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE H.T. NARENDRA PRASAD
ORAL JUDGMENT

This appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act',
for short) has been filed by the Insurance Company being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 19.06.2017 passed by the Additional Senior Civil Judge, MACT, Srirangapatna (hereinafter referred to as 'the Tribunal') in MVC No.916/2016.

entities.text: Additional Senior Civil Judge, MACT, Srirangapatna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Facts giving rise to the filing of the appeal briefly stated are that on 22.12.2014 at about 1.50 p.m.,
when the deceased Siddalingaiah was proceeding on motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-11/Y-8245 near Pashchima Vahini on Bangalore-Mysore road, at that time, he NC:
2024:KHC:37648 suddenly skid and he could not control the motorcycle.
As a result he fell down and sustained grievous injuries and succumbed to the injuries.
3. The claimants filed a petition under Section 163-A of the Act seeking compensation for the death of the deceased along with interest.
4. Upon service of notice, the respondent appeared through counsel and filed written statement denying the averments made in the claim petition.

5. On the basis of the pleadings of the parties, the Claims Tribunal framed the issues and thereafter,
recorded the evidence.

The claimants, in order to prove the case, examined claimant No.1 as PW-1,
and got exhibited documents namely Ex.P1 to Ex.P11.
On behalf of respondents, one witness was examined as RW-1 and got exhibited documents namely Ex.R1 to Ex.R6.

The Claims Tribunal, by the impugned judgment, inter alia, held that the accident took place on account of rash and The National Insurance Co Ltd vs Smt. Rathnamma on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194600838/
2 negligent riding of the deceased himself, as a result of which, the NC: 2024:KHC:37648 deceased sustained injuries and succumbed to the injuries.

entities.text: National Insurance Co Ltd vs Smt. Rathnamma on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Tribunal further held that the claimants are entitled to a compensation of Rs.2,25,500/- along with interest at the rate of 9% p.a. and directed the Insurance Company to deposit the compensation amount along with interest.

Being aggrieved,
this appeal has been filed.
6. The learned counsel for the Insurance Company submits that the claim petition is filed under Section 163-A of the Act by the insured himself.
The petition is not maintainable.

The Tribunal,
without considering this aspect of the matter allowed the claim petition and granted compensation of Rs.2,25,500/-.
The same is subject to condition mentioned in the policy.

He further submits that in the light of the Division Bench decision of this Court in the case of MS.JOYEETA BOSE AND OTHERS -V- VENKATESHAN.V AND OTHERS (MFA 5896/2018 AND CONNECTED MATTERS DISPOSED OF ON 24.8.2020), the rate of interest awarded by the NC: 2024:KHC:37648 Tribunal at 9% p.a. on the compensation amount is on the higher side.

entities.text: MS.JOYEETA BOSE AND OTHERS -V- VENKATESHAN.V AND OTHERS (MFA 5896/2018
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Hence, sought to allow the appeal.
7. The respondents are served and unrepresented.

8. Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and perused the judgment and award of the Tribunal.
9.
It is not in dispute that Siddalingaiah died in the road traffic accident occurred on 22.12.2014 due to rash and negligent driving of the deceased himself.
He is the insured of the vehicle.

Under the insurance policy, which has been marked as Ex.R1, the Insurance Company has collected a premium of Rs.50/- for PA cover for the owner and driver and fixed the compensation in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-.

Hence, the claimants are entitled to a total compensation of Rs.1,00,000/-.
10.

In the result, the following order is passed:
ORDER
(i) The appeal is allowed in part.
NC: 2024:KHC:37648 (ii) The judgment of the Claims Tribunal is modified.

(iii) The claimants are entitled to a total compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- as against Rs.2,25,500/-
awarded by the Tribunal.

(iv) Following the judgment of the Division Bench of this Court in the case of 'MS.JOYEETA BOSE'
(supra), the rate of interest awarded by the Tribunal at 9% p.a. is reduced to 6% p.a.

(v) The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation amount along with interest @
6% p.a. from the date of filing of the claim petition till the date of realization, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
